title: Remember My Text
description: Adding an auto message saver, increasing the max message length and expanding the message history.
body:
**[Aquarius Libs](https://modrinth.com/mod/aquarius-libs)** needs to be installed for this mod to work!

This **fully client-side** is adding an auto message saver, increasing the max message length and expanding the message history.

 ---

What it does:

- **Expanded Message History:** lets you scroll back through thousands of past lines in the chat window. (configurable, can be disabled, and by default max message number is increased to 4096, you can increase this number or disable this function in the configs)

- **Longer Messages:** can type now longer messages, but **to make sure your server is not kicking you out**, long text entries are broken down into smaller, vanilla-sized (256 length) messages. Like this the mod will work on any server without being kicked out. (configurable, can be disabled, and be default the max message length is 1024, you can increase this number or disable this function in the configs)

- **Auto Message Saver:** your chat will create a backup file in the **"logs\chatmessages\world name(or server ip)\current date.txt"** folder, so you can check your last chat messages if you forgot about something. **By default this is enabled**, you can disable this function in the configs if you want to use it.

 ---

Supported Versions

- **Side:** Client-Only

- **Loaders:** Forge, Fabric, and NeoForge.

- **Versions: 26.1.x**


 ---

Found a Bug?

If you encounter any **bugs** or experience a **crash**, please **send** the **crash log** directly to me via **[curseforge private message](https://legacy.curseforge.com/members/aleni26/projects)** so I can look into it.
